audio_description:
Squall holds Rinoa close, their helmets pressed together against the stars.
Rinoa's face eases as she comes back to consciousness.
The shot fades to the black of space.

context.scene_title: Squall and Rinoa reunited in space — Rinoa revived (Disc 3).
